messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: Hosted API P0 — sustained queue growth and p99 > 10s. Runbook: /runbooks/hosted-queue
alice: seeing p95 ~4200ms, p99 ~12s. Hosted queue length: 28,430 requests, growth rate ~600 req/s last 5m
ben: gpu-pool-hosted-1 at 100% util. Node count stuck at 80/80 (max)
charu: Autoscaler logs show repeated failures: "scale request denied: quota exceeded for nodes.gpu.instances". Cloud quota is saturated
danny: multiple customers reporting 504s since ~10:02 UTC. Support triage marking as customer-impacting
alice: trying soft mitigations: enabling model fallback on route /v1/generate to small-quant canary 10%
frank: small-quant is cheaper but lower throughput; okay for canary. Also suggest token cap and short-circuit common prompts with KV cache
alice: running:
```
redwoodctl routes set-fallback --route /v1/generate --fallback-model small-quant --pct 10
```
ben: requested quota bump from cloud provider; ETA 3-6 hours, not an immediate fix
gpu-autoscaler-bot: Autoscaler attempted scale at 1954321120 -> requested +12 nodes. Response: REJECTED quota-exceeded
charu: immediate plan: 1) increase fallback to 40% 2) apply temporary per-key rate limits for noisy keys 3) disable non-critical batch jobs using GPUs
alice: increasing fallback to 40% now
```
redwoodctl routes set-fallback --route /v1/generate --fallback-model small-quant --pct 40
```
ben: applying rate limits to top noisy keys (IDs: key-34, key-77, key-101) now
danny: drafting status page update and customer emails, pinging @erica for approval
erica: draft approved. Posting incident notice to status with "mitigations in progress" and ETA note
alice: after fallback bump, queue growth slowed to ~160 req/s and queue length plateaued ~29k
charu: p95 dropped to ~2.1s, p99 ~6.5s. Degraded but stabilizing
ben: killed 4 non-critical batch jobs consuming GPUs (batch-az3-21, batch-az3-22, batch-az3-23, batch-az3-24)
frank: added temporary spike protector: reject requests >10k tokens with 429 to stop noisy large requests
danny: Support tagged 14 customers as potentially impacted; sending proactive emails now
alice: preparing to hand off in 20m. Ben, can you take the rest? Key risks: autoscaler still hitting quota, we may see another spike
ben: taking over. TL;DR: fallback 40%, rate limits applied, batch jobs killed, quota request pending. Monitoring dashboards and traces
charu: post-incident action items (captured here): - add alert for autoscaler quota-rejections - increase reserved GPU headroom for hosted pool - update runbook to check cloud quotas before scale windows
erica: I'll coordinate customer comms and SLA evaluation. Need list of impacted customers and minutes of degraded service
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress, impact reduced. PagerDuty: acknowledged by alice and ben
ben: Handoff note: do NOT increase hosted max nodes beyond 80 without infra approval. Continue incremental fallback increases only if p99 remains >8s. Contact infra if quota request ETA changes
alice: thanks — adding final handoff pointer: runbook /runbooks/hosted-queue and link to autoscaler logs: /logs/autoscaler/1954321000. Next update scheduled at 1954321600
